title: C: Network (Simulated)
description: Simulate a simple network protocol with packet creation, sending, and receiving over a virtual channel.

steps.title: Packet Creation and Send
steps.description: Define a `Packet` struct with src, dst, type, payload (char[64]), and length. Write `void send_packet(Packet *p)` that prints the packet details. Create a packet from 1 to 2 with payload 'Hello' and send it.
hints: Packet fields: src, dst, type (DATA/ACK), payload, len.

verification.failureMessage: Create and send a packet from node 1 to node 2
